held.title: `self.url()` can cost an extra Hub request on every read that goes to the Hub.
held.body: In `huggingface_hub`, `HfFileSystemFile.url()` calls `self.fs.url(self.path)`. That re-resolves the path and then calls `self.isdir(path)`, which goes through `info()`. If that info is not already in the dircache, it is an extra `paths_info` call to the Hub on the first read and again after every expired-URL fallback. The upstream `_fetch_range` builds the URL straight from `self.resolved_path` with `hf_hub_url`, which needs no network. The new tests replace `fs.info` with a stub, so they would not show the extra call. I could not see the installed `huggingface_hub` version or whether `PinnedHfFileSystem` overrides `url`, so this may not happen. Fix: build the URL from `self.resolved_path` with `hf_hub_url`, the same way upstream does.
